name: Control Center
alt: Control Center open over the desktop: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sleep, night volume, volume, brightness, text size, appearance and the phone
caption: Press Menu in any app.

name: Settings
alt: Settings: the sections on the left, and Speed and memory on the right: free up memory, quicker animations, and which apps keep running in the background
caption: Every setting in one window, with search. Speed & memory frees up a slow TV.

name: Open apps
alt: The open apps over the desktop, as cards to choose from
caption: Hold Home for the apps that are open.

name: Weather
alt: The weather: now, today and the next four days, and the town it's for
caption: Today and the next four days.

name: Search
alt: Search: “net” finds Netflix, the Network & Bluetooth settings, and offers to ask Glass
caption: Apps, settings, files and questions, in one box.

name: All apps
alt: All apps: every app on the TV in a grid
caption: Every app on the TV, in one grid.

name: Files
alt: Files: places on the left and what's in the chosen one
caption: USB drives, downloads and what your phone sends.

name: Inputs
alt: The TV's sources as a glass menu: HDMI 3, 2 and 1, AV and Live TV
caption: Press Input for the TV's sources.

name: Screen saver
